script.vo: Cintas shows up in two bank memos. COUNTIF finds zero.
Vendor list up top, one row each.
script.caption: Vendors, one row each.

script.vo: Below that, the bank feed. The vendor name's buried in reference junk.
script.caption:
The memos below bury
the vendor name.

script.vo: So you point COUNTIF at the memos and put asterisks around A2, inside the quotes.
script.caption:
Asterisks around A2.
Inside the quotes.

script.vo: Inside the quotes, A2 stopped being a reference. Excel went looking for the letter A and a two. The reference has to sit outside the quotes.
script.caption:
Excel looked for A2 itself.
Move A2 out of the quotes.

script.vo: The asterisks still work as wildcards, so keep them and join A2 on with ampersands.
script.caption:
Join it on with
*ampersands*.

script.vo: Fill it down and every vendor gets a real count.
script.caption:
Fill down.
Real counts.

script.vo: Inside the quotes, A2 is just two characters. The reference goes outside.

post.title: COUNTIF returns 0 when the vendor name is buried in the memo
post.description:
countif with a wildcard and a cell reference returns 0
A cell reference inside quotes is plain text to Excel, so put it outside the quotes and join it on with ampersands. Save this for the next bank feed reconciliation.
